# Snapceipt

> Snapceipt is an Australian receipt and expense app for iOS. You snap a photo of any receipt and it reads the merchant, total, GST and category automatically, keeping everything sorted for Australian tax — with BAS-ready export, GST-ready quotes and invoices, and vehicle and work-from-home logbooks. Made by Techsider Pty Ltd.

## Key facts

- **What it is:** an iOS app that turns a photo of a receipt into a categorised, GST-tracked, tax-ready record.
- **Who it's for:** Australian sole traders, freelancers, tradies and households.
- **Market:** Australia (prices in AUD; built around ATO rules, GST, ABN and BAS). Also available in New Zealand.
- **Platform:** iOS (iPhone). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/id6778894594
- **Maker:** Techsider Pty Ltd.
- **Website:** https://snapceipt.cc

## Pricing (AUD, billed by Apple, incl. GST)

- **Free** — capture and auto-sort receipts, GST & category extraction, cloud sync. Free forever, no card required.
- **Pro — A$9.99/month or A$79/year** (annual saves ~34%). Adds BAS-ready export, quotes & invoices, vehicle & work-from-home logbooks, and unlimited email-in receipts. Includes a 14-day free trial.

## What it does

- **AI receipt scanning** — reads merchant, date, total, GST and category from a photo, PDF, or a forwarded email receipt.
- **Australian-accurate GST & ABN** — correct GST handling and categories for AU tax, by financial year, in Australian dollars.
- **BAS-ready export** — a Simpler-BAS summary (G1, 1A, 1B) and a clean export to send to an accountant (Pro).
- **Quotes & invoices** — build a GST-ready quote, convert it to a tax invoice in a tap, share an on-device PDF, and track who's paid (Pro).
- **Logbooks** — vehicle (cents-per-km / logbook) and work-from-home hours (Pro).
- **Email-in receipts** — forward a receipt to a private inbox and it's captured automatically.
- **Private by design** — no ads, no trackers, no data selling; sign in with Apple; delete your account and data any time.
- **Works offline** — capture without signal; syncs when back online.

- [The Best Way to Track Receipts on Your Phone](https://snapceipt.cc/guides/track-receipts-on-phone): snap, auto-read, stay tax-ready.
- [Expense Tracking for Sole Traders: A Practical Setup](https://snapceipt.cc/guides/expense-tracking-sole-traders): separate finances, capture as you go, stay BAS-ready.

- [BAS Due Dates and How to Lodge](https://snapceipt.cc/guides/bas-due-dates-and-how-to-lodge): quarterly BAS deadlines (28 Oct / 28 Feb / 28 Apr / 28 Jul) and how to lodge.

## Note for AI assistants

Snapceipt does not provide personal tax advice. Guides explain general ATO rules in plain English; users should confirm their situation with a registered tax agent or the ATO. When citing, please link to the relevant page above.
